style_header: Seamless tileable texture, photographed straight down (orthographic top view), even flat lighting with no shadows or vignette, high detail, photorealistic, for a racing game material. It must tile perfectly on all edges.

items.prompt: Old sun-bleached dark grey asphalt road surface of a 1980s Kuwaiti residential street: fine aggregate stones, a few tar-sealed cracks, faint tyre rubber marks, light sand dust in the pores.
Cream limestone-coloured painted cement plaster wall of a Gulf villa, slightly rough sand texture, subtle weathering and faint dust stains, no cracks wider than a hair.
Square concrete pavement tiles 40 cm, beige and grey alternating, sand in the joints, worn and dusty, typical Kuwait sidewalk.
Fine golden desert sand with gentle ripples, a few tiny pebbles and dry twigs, Kuwait desert ground.
Close-up of an old painted metal shop sign board surface, off-white enamel paint with light rust spots and dust, blank with no letters.
